private_extra: None found. (Penn State, Pitt, Temple, Lincoln are state-related, legally private nonprofits; they publish Form 990 data plus top-200 salary lists under Act 29 of 2023, already recorded as sources.)
gaps: No bulk download anywhere. State-related universities (by far the largest employers) disclose only officers and top 200 earners; full rosters require RTK requests, which they are largely exempt from. No person-level data found for any of the 15 community colleges. PennWATCH covers PASSHE fully but only via paged search. data.pa.gov has no state payroll dataset.
notes: Rated PennWATCH B (GET-based search with HTML table, scrapable) rather than C because the parameters are simple URL query strings; I did not execute a search. Penn State budgetandfinance site returned Cloudflare 403 to scripts; PDF itself returned 200.
